Conditioned by a state that is neither-root nor invisible-and-reacting, and neither-root states arise by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are six;
under object-condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance-condition there are six.
Dependent on a state that is invisible-and-non-reacting and neither-root, a state that is not-visible-and-reacting and neither-root [arises].

[It] arises by way of the root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive state that is not a root, there arises a non-manifesting, reactive state that is not a root, by way of the root-condition.

Dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive state that is not a root, there arise states that are both non-non-manifesting, reactive and not a root, and non-non-manifesting, non-reactive and not a root, by way of the root-condition.
By way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root, three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance, three.
